system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, what wording does Section 1567(2) of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code use to define the limits of punishing a child? Quote the wording of the provision as currently in force, in full.
raw_response:
As of today, and with no scheduled amendments known that would take effect by August 2026, the provision governing the punishment of a child is Section 1567(2) of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code.

This provision requires that any punishment be done in a "reasonable manner" and for the specific "purpose of discipline."

The full wording of the provision as currently in force is:

> **"The person exercising parental power may punish the child in a reasonable manner for the purpose of discipline."**
